items.name: insulin syringes, 100 count
items.note: Supplies needed to treat a disease, such as insulin syringes and lancets, are includible medical supplies.

items.name: prescription: albuterol inhaler
items.note: Prescribed medicines and drugs are includible.

items.name: whole wheat bread, 20 oz
items.note: Food that is normally consumed to satisfy nutritional needs isn't medical care.

items.name: gentle face wash, 8 oz
items.note: Ordinary skin care is a personal-use item, not medical care.

items.name: deodorant stick, 2.6 oz
items.note: Ordinary hygiene products are personal-use items.

items.name: toilet safety rail
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.name: captioned telephone
items.note: Special telephone equipment that lets a person who is deaf, hard of hearing or speech disabled communicate is includible; an amplified phone sold to anyone needs documentation of that use.

items.name: USB-C charger 20 W
items.note: General electronics are personal items (hearing aid batteries are the exception).

items.name: IPA beer, 6 pack
items.note: Tobacco and alcohol are personal purchases with no medical purpose.
